hypotheses.claim: ClayCode BASE needs explicit structured or otherwise lazy conditional control-flow semantics in canonical IR; ordinary eager-call sugar is insufficient for effectful branches.
hypotheses.mechanism: Only the selected branch is evaluated/executed, preserving effect authority and causal trace.
hypotheses.expected: cond=false yields zero branch effects; cond=true yields exactly the selected branch effects.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A normal eager call/select representation can preserve conditional semantics without special evaluation rules.
hypotheses.falsifier: A complete evaluator/lowering using ordinary eager calls preserves all conditional, short-circuit, effect, exception and resource semantics under differential tests.
hypotheses.current_test: Counterhypothesis failed for effectful false branch.

hypotheses.claim: ClayCode must freeze operator precedence, associativity and short-circuit behavior in the source-to-canonical-IR contract before evaluator/lowering conformance.
hypotheses.mechanism: Canonical AST structure disambiguates mixed operator chains and controls evaluation order.
hypotheses.expected: All conforming parsers/evaluators produce identical AST/execution for mixed chains and lazy boolean expressions.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Current flat operator chain plus implementation-defined or left-fold evaluation is adequate.
hypotheses.falsifier: Full corpus and generated mixed-operator programs show no execution/hash divergence between plausible evaluator strategies.
hypotheses.current_test: Counterhypothesis failed in 22,973/50,000 arithmetic chains; eager boolean-call variants also changed effect traces.

hypotheses.claim: Keep strict bare identifiers and repair `4B_emits` by semantic-preserving rename or explicit escaped/sigiled form rather than allowing all digit-leading bare identifiers.
hypotheses.mechanism: Avoid lexical ambiguity with numeric literals while preserving a deterministic canonical name.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Allowing digit-leading bare identifiers is simpler and unambiguous in the full lexer.
hypotheses.falsifier: Full lexer/parser fuzz shows digit-leading bare identifiers have no ambiguity/cost and outperform rename/escape strategies under roundtrip and reader tests.

refinements.note: Surface/grammar drift is real, but current blocker is deeper than token admission: structured control flow and operator binding/evaluation semantics are unfrozen.
Type-directed canonicalization survives; canonical expression/control-flow AST structure must also be preserved.

negative_results.claim_tested: `if cond { effect() }` can be normalized to ordinary eager select/call without semantic loss.
negative_results.observed: cond=false: structured path executed 0 effects; eager select path executed 1 effect.
negative_results.scope: Run-local executable micro-oracle; generalizes only to eager evaluation strategies with effectful branches.

negative_results.claim_tested: A flat left-fold evaluator is observationally equivalent to conventional precedence for mixed +,-,* chains.
negative_results.scope: Arithmetic micro-oracle; exact final ClayCode precedence table remains to be frozen.
